info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Bill Pay Switches Retrieval API
info.description: The Bill Pay Switches Retrieval API allows businesses to access the status of bill pay switches for individual customers. This endpoint is essential for financial institutions and service providers looking to manage customer preferences regarding bill payments. By querying a specific customer's bill pay switch status, developers can ensure personalized experiences and streamline payment processes. Typical consumers of this API include customer service representatives and fintech applications that enhance user engagement and transaction efficiency.

get.summary: Retrieve bill pay switches for a specific customer.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current bill pay switches status for the specified customer identified by their unique ID. It provides details on whether the bill pay feature is enabled or disabled for the customer.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the bill pay switches for a specific customer identified by CUST-100045. It contains the necessary parameters required to perform the GET operation.

200.description: The request was successful, and the bill pay switches data is returned.
